## Bit packing

BitWriter and BitReader, the family wire underneath every stream, in two-lane 32-bit arithmetic.

<!-- nova-work:bitpacker:start -->

| feature | done |
|---|:---:|
| BitWriter: any width 1-32 at any bit offset, trailing bits zeroed | ✅ |
| BitReader: any width at any offset, refuses past the end | ✅ |
| reads any data length with no slack past the data | ✅ |
| bulk byte copy, identical to per-byte bits | ✅ |
| reset for allocation-free reuse | ✅ |
| a faster BitReader using the 8-byte slack from spare ArrayBuffer capacity, measured | ❌ |
| complete | 83% |

[Source data](docs/roadmap.sexp)

<!-- nova-work:bitpacker:end -->

## Operations

The complete family operation set on WriteStream, ReadStream and MeasureStream: one serialize function writes, reads and measures.

<!-- nova-work:operations:start -->

| feature | done |
|---|:---:|
| one serialize function for write, read and measure | ✅ |
| raw bits (1-32, 1-64) and align | ✅ |
| ranged integers: 32, 64 and 128 bit | ✅ |
| unsigned helpers (8 to 128 bit) and bool | ✅ |
| float and double, bit transparent | ✅ |
| compressed float | ✅ |
| bytes | ✅ |
| UTF-8 strings | ✅ |
| wide strings (UTF-16 code units) | ✅ |
| relative integer for increasing sequences | ✅ |
| fixed point (Q formats, 8 to 128 bit storage) | ✅ |
| range pricing: bitsRequired 32, 64 and 128 | ✅ |
| measure never under-prices a write | ✅ |
| complete | 100% |

[Source data](docs/roadmap.sexp)

## Errors and hostile input

Errors are values, the read side is a trust boundary in every mode, and the write path forks once into checked and production variants.

<!-- nova-work:safety:start -->

| feature | done |
|---|:---:|
| errors as values: a sticky latched stream error | ✅ |
| hostile input never throws | ✅ |
| every operation refuses malformed data, proven both ways | ✅ |
| checked build: caller misuse throws | ✅ |
| production mode (NODE_ENV=production) trusts the caller, same wire | ✅ |
| complete | 100% |

[Source data](docs/roadmap.sexp)

<!-- nova-work:safety:end -->
